playstyle.identity: Alistar is a tanky engage support with a devastating headbutt-pulverize combo. He excels at initiating fights and peeling for carries.
playstyle.howToPlay: W-Q combo (headbutt into instant pulverize) is your bread and butter for engage. E heals nearby allies when you auto. R cleanses CC and massively reduces damage taken. Flash-Q for surprise engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Alistar spikes at level 2 with W-Q combo and level 6 with damage reduction. Tank items make him nearly unkillable during R. He's strong at all stages as an engager.

passive.name: Triumphant Roar
passive.summary: Heal yourself and nearby allies when you stun or enemies die nearby.
passive.details: Alistar builds Triumph stacks when enemies die nearby or he stuns/knocks up. At full stacks, he heals himself and nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.summary: Stomp the ground to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing magic damage and knocking up enemies around him. Core part of the W-Q engage combo.

abilities.name: Headbutt
abilities.summary: Charge to an enemy, knocking them back and stunning briefly.
abilities.details: Alistar dashes to a target enemy, dealing damage and knocking them back. Can be used to knock enemies into your team or instantly followed by Q to combo.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.summary: Deal damage around you; at max stacks, next auto stuns.
abilities.details: Alistar tramples the ground around him, dealing damage over time. Each tick against champions builds stacks; at max stacks, his next auto attack stuns.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
abilities.summary: Cleanse CC and massively reduce incoming damage.
abilities.details: Alistar roars, removing all crowd control and taking massively reduced damage for several seconds. Lets him dive towers and survive focus.
